description: Implementation of the ProductOptionValueService interface, providing operations to manage ProductOptionValue entities such as listing, retrieving by ID, name, or code, saving/updating, and deleting, with integration to a DAO layer and handling related entities like ProductAttribute.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for handling product option values, providing CRUD operations and business logic for product option value entities.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductOptionValue for the specified MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductOptionValue for the store, without read-only constraints.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its ID within a given store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptionValues by name for a store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new entity or updates an existing ProductOptionValue.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductOptionValue and related ProductAttributes from the store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its code for a store.
